bio: This friendly restaurant (which also offers accommodation) is idyllically located to explore the picturesque small town of Durbuy. You will feel right at home here thanks to the family-run vibe and attentive care lavished by chef Timmerman on his guests. The pedigree French repertory is enhanced by local produce, such as scallops and venison. The chef treats all his ingredients with the utmost respect, further enhancing the experience with fascinating sauces and side dishes....
